title: TEA .well-known discovery document
description: JSON Schema for the TEA .well-known/tea discovery payload that lists available TEA API endpoints and supported versions.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for the TEA .well-known discovery document. Currently always 1.

endpoints.description: List of available TEA service endpoints and their supported versions.

url.description: Base URL of the TEA API endpoint (no trailing slash).

versions.description: Supported TEA API versions for this endpoint. Clients select the highest mutually supported version and append /v followed by that exact advertised string (no leading v in the array values).

items.description: TEA OpenAPI Spec version identifier. MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional SemVer 2.0.0 prerelease (https://semver.org/). Build metadata (+…) is not used in advertised API path versions.

priority.description: Optional priority for this endpoint. Higher values indicate higher priority. Range: 0 to 1. If omitted in the JSON response, clients shall treat the effective priority as 1 (JSON Schema default does not populate omitted fields).
